name: Jerk Chicken with Rice and Peas
steps: Season the chicken thighs with allspice, thyme, and chopped spring onion.
Grill or fry the chicken over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through to 74C internal.
Meanwhile, simmer the kidney beans with the coconut milk and onion in a pot for about 10 minutes.
Stir the cooked rice into the coconut-bean mixture and warm through.
Serve the jerk chicken over the rice and peas.
